name: Blue Cash Everyday Card from American Express

intro_offer.headline: $200 statement credit
intro_offer.spend_requirement: $2,000 in purchases in the first 6 months

rewards.on: US supermarkets, up to $6,000 per year in purchases (then 1%)
US online retail purchases, up to $6,000 per year (then 1%)
US gas stations, up to $6,000 per year (then 1%)

regular_apr: 19.24% to 29.99% variable, depending on your credit
intro_apr: 0% for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers
rating_reason: 3% at supermarkets with no annual fee is solid. The $6,000 per category cap and no bonus on dining limit its ceiling. A reasonable choice if you want grocery rewards without paying an annual fee.
best_for: grocery shoppers who do not want to pay an annual fee
skip_if: your grocery bill is over $500 a month; the Blue Cash Preferred's 6% will earn more even after the $95 fee
